Tests for {@link Symmetry010Chronology} and {@link Symmetry010Date}.

The Symmetry010 calendar has 12 months arranged in 4 quarters of 91 days each (30 + 31 + 30 days). Normal years have 364 days; leap years have an extra 7-day week appended to December, giving 371 days.

All dates are compared against ISO (Gregorian) equivalents to validate the epoch-day conversion logic that underpins the calendar implementation.
Calendar structure constants used to make test data arithmetic self-documenting. Each quarter has months of 30, 31, and 30 days = 91 days = 13 weeks.
